column1: # tab:dbuf-ablation: array task -> game -> raw job id -> end time.
# The 24 data files are all named dbuf_t3_44861569_<game>.json, but the job_id
# INSIDE each file differs. That inner value is SLURM_JOB_ID, which for an array
# task is the per-task JobIDRaw, not the array job id -- so the files look like
# 24 separate jobs and are not. All 24 are tasks of ONE array job, 44861569
# 2026-09-06T15:00:50, finishing 2026-09-07T08:07:20. %1 means the tasks ran one
# at a time, so no two games shared the node. Every data file maps to exactly one
# task and every task produced one file.
